reviews.title: FTM necessity
reviews.contents: As a first-time mum, I love using the Nara Baby, our app to track breastfeeding, as our baby is having issues with his latch, this has become a lifesaver for us! Also love that feeds can be logged from an Apple Watch. This is a huge bonus!

reviews.title: Only baby tracker I’ll use
reviews.contents: I love the simplicity, other apps have SO many different sections, buttons, and simply unnecessary additions. I LOVE how simple Nara is, it’s so quick to add whatever you need & be done with it. I even opted to pay for a subscription when they added it, because no other apps compare ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ wish I had it for my first born!

reviews.title: Ya no.
reviews.contents: This was my go to app, using it for coming up on four years all for it to switch to an expensive subscription model, incredibly disappointing. Especially since the subscription doesn’t seem to be adding features.

reviews.title: Subscriptions only app halfway through usage, migrated to about free app
reviews.contents: Have been using it for Tue last few months to track my baby. Now the app is subscription only, that too for a high fee. I was able toto migrate to Pebbi. It is a good app with a free tier and easy to import data from Nara baby

reviews.title: Not free anymore
reviews.contents: Majority of the good reviews are based on the free access including ad-free. I guess higher demand brought opportunity to make money as opposed to helping new parents track their baby.

reviews.title: So disappointed
reviews.contents: I have loved this app for 3 1/2 years using it for both of my children for tracking milestones, feeding, weight changes, all of the stuff and find out it’s now locking me out because I have to pay a subscription is extremely disappointing.

reviews.title: Only for Paid Subscribers??
reviews.contents: I had been using this app for the last year and now it’s completely inaccessible unless we subscribe. There isn’t even a free version? I’m really disappointed

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.contents: The app was sincerely the best one. I recommended it to all of my friends but now they changed it and they charge you to use it. I have to find another free app that does the same.

reviews.title: Subscription now??
reviews.contents: Great for tracking things, and I've used it semi-regularly for a while. Today I got a message saying I'll lose editing access in 7 days and be limited to read-only. Not impressed with the sudden change.

reviews.title: Was fine, until they bricked it if you don’t subscribe
reviews.contents: Used to be fine, we never used all the features, just the feeding logs. For my firstborn we had no issues, but now they are adding a subscription plan and it will render the app useless unless you pay. I feel like that could’ve been integrated in a way where the current users lose some secondary features but can still use feeding logs, the main purpose of the app, without having to pay. Now we got to find another tracking app just for the next 2 months, at which point we won’t need it anymore.
